client_problem: Estimate hidden scene or image parameters by matching rendered output to observed pixels.
client_scenario: A client has an observed target image and wants to recover compact visual parameters that reproduce it closely enough for inspection or calibration.
paper_family_claim: Inverse-rendering papers convert visual mismatch into parameter updates.
related_siggraph_papers: Lucky High Dynamic Range Smartphone Imaging
Inverse Rendering for Discrete X-Ray Computed Tomography
Fiber-level Woven Fabric Capture from a Single Microscopic Image
core_algorithm: finite-difference gradient descent over renderer parameters
demo_proves: Pixel loss gives a measurable direction for improving hidden shape parameters.
